summary: Comprehensive testing of the new multi-provider AI Assistant feature (Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini via Emergent LLM key) plus regression on files/system-status/search. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed including SSE streaming for all 3 providers with grounded answers referencing real order numbers (#58311, #58316, #58319) and correctly stating 0 open exceptions; conversation memory + history GET/DELETE work; provider/message validation returns 400; safety checks pass (no hallucinated 'printed' or 'device online' claims). Frontend: /assistant page loads, all 3 provider buttons render, textarea + send + streaming indicator + user/assistant bubbles all appear, ReadableStream-based SSE consumption renders streamed replies from all 3 providers, provider switch routes correctly (bubble shows correct provider label), suggestion chips send, New chat clears state and generates new session_id, and localStorage session persists across page reload (history reloads).
critical_code_review_comments: ai_assistant.py history endpoint returns messages including 'provider' and 'model' fields but frontend Assistant.jsx only reads role/content/provider for rendering — fine, but consider showing timestamps.
Assistant.jsx fmt() only handles **bold** and newlines; markdown lists (## and *) from LLMs render as literal chars. Consider a small markdown renderer.
In Assistant.jsx send(), if fetch throws before resp.body exists there is no visible error toast — the bubble just contains a warning string; acceptable for MVP.
server.py backend is >700 lines (existing) — not blocking, but future refactor suggested (already flagged in prior iterations).
test_credentials: N/A — app is open by design (no auth).
seed_data_creation: None. Tests use existing seed orders (#58311, #58316, #58319). Assistant test sessions use TEST_ prefix and are cleaned up via DELETE /api/assistant/history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Assistant feature is fully working end-to-end. Backend SSE at POST /api/assistant/chat streams data:{delta} then data:{done:true}. Frontend at /assistant consumes stream via fetch+ReadableStream. Tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_assistant.py. Regression on /api/files, /api/system-status, /api/dashboard/stats, /api/search all still pass.
